name: cmu-re-no-stitcher
author: CMU-Revised
description: Turns off Stitcher: its service (blm_ira_stitcher) and backend (irsstitcher_server) do not start at boot, MMUI no longer loads its screen module, and the Stitcher entry leaves the Entertainment list. Uninstall and restart to get the stock behaviour back.

files.reason: Stitcher service and its backend off at boot; they never reset the board
Stitcher service and its backend off at boot; they never reset the board
MMUI no longer loads the screen module(s) of this service, which it loads one by one before it answers the GUI
removes the Stitcher entry from the Entertainment list
